title: Titanium Ultrasonic Nodal Clamp Ring
alloyReason: Triaxially forged Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Triaxially Forged) (UNS R56400) is specified for this ultrasonic tooling component where isotropic properties are mandatory. The 3D forging eliminates texture directionality, delivering uniform 950 MPa tensile in all orientations under multi-axial stress. This rationale is driven by stack clamping nodal ring flange (grade 4) and service environment demands.
process: CNC turn-mill multi-axis for ultrasonic tooling geometry
Shot peening Almen for net-shape tolerance
Black oxide/DLC coating for net-shape tolerance
CMM SPC dimensional check for net-shape tolerance
surfaceTreatment: DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability — tailored for stack clamping nodal application
commonFailures: Brinelling of Al housing from steel insert - resolved by steel-backed bronze bushing SAE 841 0.05mm interfer — critical for stack clamping nodal performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Ultrasonic Nodal Clamp Ring suitable for Stack clamping nodal ring flange (Grade 4)?
faq.a: Titanium Ultrasonic Nodal Clamp Ring uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address ultrasonic tooling operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Ultrasonic Nodal Clamp Ring?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Ultrasonic Nodal Clamp Ring is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for stack clamping nodal requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Ultrasonic Nodal Clamp Ring require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. stack clamping nodal components require DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability — tailored for stack clamping nodal application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Ultrasonic Nodal Clamp Ring shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Ultrasonic Nodal Clamp Ring includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet stack clamping nodal specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
